title: M5 stage15: ordered tuple character-power counting
scope: Five tuple character identities, including empty cases; specialization to polynomial residues remains separate

spec.name: M5.TupleCharacter.value_zero
spec.guidance: Unfold value and bitSign; each product factor is (-1)^0=1. The empty product at D=0 is one. No positivity hypothesis. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact statements.

spec.name: M5.TupleCharacter.character_tuple_sum
spec.statement: ∀ (D n k : ℕ) (f : Fin n → M5.Character.BinaryVector D) (t : Fin k → Fin n) (lam : M5.Character.BinaryVector D), M5.Character.value lam (M5.TupleCharacter.vectorSum f t) = ∏ i : Fin k, M5.Character.value lam (f (t i))
spec.guidance: Prove a general Finset finite-sum-to-product helper locally by induction using accepted character_add and value_zero, then specialize to Finset.univ. Alternatively use induction on k and Fin.sum_univ_succ/Fin.prod_univ_succ. Tuple functions permit repeated values. Empty tuple must yield one. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact statements.

spec.name: M5.TupleCharacter.tuple_character_power
spec.statement: ∀ (D n k : ℕ) (f : Fin n → M5.Character.BinaryVector D) (lam : M5.Character.BinaryVector D), (∑ t : Fin k → Fin n, M5.Character.value lam (M5.TupleCharacter.vectorSum f t)) = (∑ a : Fin n, M5.Character.value lam (f a)) ^ k
spec.guidance: Rewrite each tuple character with character_tuple_sum. Fintype.sum_pow (fun a : Fin n => M5.Character.value lam (f a)) k gives the result in reverse orientation. Source Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Ring.Finset has this theorem, including empty alphabet and k=0. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact statements.

spec.name: M5.TupleCharacter.tuple_character_count
spec.statement: ∀ (D n k : ℕ) (f : Fin n → M5.Character.BinaryVector D) (z : M5.Character.BinaryVector D), (∑ lam : M5.Character.BinaryVector D, M5.Character.value lam z * ∑ t : Fin k → Fin n, M5.Character.value lam (M5.TupleCharacter.vectorSum f t)) = (2 : ℤ) ^ D * (M5.TupleCharacter.count k f z : ℤ)
spec.guidance: Distribute multiplication over the tuple sum and swap finite sums. Combine the two characters via character_add, then apply accepted character_orthogonality. Over BinaryVector D, z+u=0 iff u=z (pointwise characteristic two, including D=0). The remaining indicator sum is the filter cardinality defining count. This is the same finite-fibre orthogonality argument as the accepted finite_fibre_count, with function tuples as the finite domain, not a support-set enumeration or distinctness constraint. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact statements.

spec.name: M5.TupleCharacter.ordered_tuple_power_count
spec.statement: ∀ (D n k : ℕ) (f : Fin n → M5.Character.BinaryVector D) (z : M5.Character.BinaryVector D), (∑ lam : M5.Character.BinaryVector D, M5.Character.value lam z * (∑ a : Fin n, M5.Character.value lam (f a)) ^ k) = (2 : ℤ) ^ D * (M5.TupleCharacter.count k f z : ℤ)
spec.guidance: Rewrite powers as tuple sums using tuple_character_power, then apply tuple_character_count. Preserve this integer identity multiplied by 2^D; do not introduce rational division or assume nonempty alphabet, positive k or positive D. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact statements.
